2653-2893-6168-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4770-5301-6723-7730.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-3899-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-3899-5632.description:
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Chalk Outline.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and Clue token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

277-3129-4094-6753-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-3129-4094-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

5189-5641-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
5189-5641-7824.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate an Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2946-4871-4976-6797.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-4976-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1263-1417-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

740-2488-7167.description:
Cast Apex Altisaur by paying {7}{G}{G}.
When Apex Altisaur enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, cast Grand Crescendo by paying {W}{W}, giving creatures you control indestructible until end of turn.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight a creature you don't control.
If the opposing creature dealt damage to Apex Altisaur, Apex Altisaur's second ability and Wrathful Raptors trigger.
Resolve the Wrathful Raptors trigger, dealing damage to any opponent.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight a creature you don't control.
Repeat from step 4 until your opponents control no creatures. If they happen to control an indestructible creature with power above 0, this loop can be done infinitely.
740-2488-7167.notes: You can restart the loop if opponents control creatures by dealing damage to Apex Altisaur. It may not have indestructible by this point however unless you use another source to provide it.

1558-2638-3147-4231-6441.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3147-4231-6441.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2292-5220-7332.description:
Cast Casey & Raph by paying {4}{R}.
When Casey & Raph enters, it triggers. Choose its first mode targeting yourself.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Casey & Raph.
When Casey & Raph dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Casey & Raph onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Resolve the Casey & Raph trigger from step 2, causing you to exile Casey & Raph from the top of your ability with the ability to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Cast Casey & Raph from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1329-3338-3581-7112.description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {1}
Mirran Spy and Kykar trigger.
Resolve the Mirran Spy, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {R}.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1115-2366-4178-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.
1115-2366-4178-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

2438-2820-3175.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Angelic Renewal triggers, causing you to sacrifice Angelic Renewal and return Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Angelic Renewal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2866-4050-4211-4986.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3705-5231-5687-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

3490-5231-5572-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3490-5231-5572-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
When the Servo dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1306-1987-4423-6650.easyPrerequisites:
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
You control three additional Islands.
1306-1987-4423-6650.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Crypt by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Crypt.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3375-5078-5741.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

671-2530-2577-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
671-2530-2577-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Daxos, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Daxos and Carnival of Souls trigger from the Zombie Druid entering the battlefield, and Daxos triggers from Gravecrawler dying.
Resolve both Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

856-997-2279-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-997-2279-4321.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

413-465-618.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake token's trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
When Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat.

1170-1636-6062.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{W}{W}.
1170-1636-6062.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{W}.
Cast Shackles by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature you control except Displacer Kitten.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking itself.
When Displacer Kitten enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Shackles spell.
Activate Shackles by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

457-1409-2034.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Construct, adding {U}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Construct, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
457-1409-2034.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Constructs. You may also use the mana to activate Urza's ability and/or blink any other creature(s).

413-678-4192-5659-5753.easyPrerequisites: "Lhurgoyf" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
413-678-4192-5659-5753.description:
Discard Circling Vultures from your hand using its static ability.
Because Circling Vultures is a Lhurgoyf due to Ashes of the Fallen, Disa the Restless's first ability triggers, putting Circling Vultures from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Circling Vultures enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Circling Vultures.
When Circling Vultures dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Circling Vultures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

703-1270-1379-2637-4659.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating six token copies of Mechtitan Core that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two of the Mechtitan Core tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate a Mechtitan Core by paying {5} and exiling it, three other Mechtitan Core tokens, and Astral Dragon, creating three 10/10 Mechtitan legendary creature tokens.
Put all but one of the Mechtitan tokens in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mechtitan Core triggers twice, returning all cards exiled to create the Mechtitan tokens from exile to the battlefield.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mechtitan, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating six token copies of Mechtitan Core that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego sacrificing Mechtitan Core tokens to Krark-Clan Ironworks, and then target any other applicable permanents using Astral Dragon.

1737-1770-3094-4636.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {6} and tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Prototype Portal's ability.
Resolve the copy of Prototype Portal's ability, creating a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart.
When the Gonti's Aether Heart token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Resolve the original Prototype Portal ability, creating a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart.
Put either Gonti's Aether Heart token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Gonti's Aether Heart token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate the remaining Gonti's Aether Heart token by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

722-3153-3455.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Sphinx of the Second Sun and Vizier of Many Faces each trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3719-4231-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with power seven or greater.
3719-4231-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Ruthless Technomancer.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice a nontoken creature you control with power seven or greater, and create at least seven Treasure, seven Food, and seven Clue artifact tokens.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing at least seven artifacts, returning a nontoken creature you control with power seven or greater from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2300-3510-3875-4875.notablePrerequisites:
"Saproling" chosen with Conspiracy.
You have a land card in hand, and are able to play a land this turn.
2300-3510-3875-4875.description:
Play a land card from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Tireless Provisioner, creating a Food or a Treasure token.
The Food or Treasure token enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling artifact creature that is also a Forest land due to Titania's Song, Life and Limb, and Conspiracy.
Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Food or a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.

890-1029-5042-5162.notablePrerequisites: Kwain and Palladium Myr do not have summoning sickness.
890-1029-5042-5162.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kwain by tapping it, causing you to draw two cards and gain 1 life, and allowing your opponent to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Tolarian Kraken triggers twice, causing you to pay {2} to untap Palladium Myr and Kwain.
Repeat.

746-2106-3652-4763.notablePrerequisites:
Mask of Immolation attached to Ornithopter.
Fighter Class is at least level two.
746-2106-3652-4763.description:
Activate Ornithopter by sacrificing it.
Ornithopter dies, triggering Koll, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ornithopter ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Activate Mask of Immolation's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Ornithopter.
Repeat.

190-389-1984-3778.description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}.
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to Angel's Grace.
Cast Austere Command by paying its mana cost, destroying all enchantments.
When each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, they each trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

298-3062-4499-4929.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Angelic Quartermaster.
Angelic Quartermaster enters the battlefield, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite and any other creature you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be used to activate abilities.
Repeat.

1261-2544.description:
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untap Time Vault.
Activate Time Vault by tapping it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
